name: Infantry_Runners
author: Infantry AI
description: Runners settings card (RUNNER-POOL-9): the runner pool's settings in one place. Only the Enable switch shows while runners.enabled is off; the rest of the card (default placement, per-runner worker caps, heartbeat) is hidden entirely until it is on. Adding a server, pausing, detaching and rotating go through `infantry runner add|pair|rotate|detach` (Infantry_RemoteRunner).

config.title: Runners
config.applies: Applies to: where ticket workers run. Off = every worker runs on this machine, as before.

fields.label: Use runners
fields.description: Off = every worker runs on this machine and this card shows nothing else.

fields.label: Default placement
fields.description: Where a ticket with no pin and no routing rule starts. `any` picks the runner that is up, has the project and harness, and has the most free slots (ties go to local); it waits when none is free.

fields.label: Local worker cap
fields.description: Most workers this machine runs at once, under the global worker cap. Other runners: set runners.<name>.maxWorkers.
